values.meaning: Damage taken grey health cap (also the base damage-taken grey-health amount stored)
bonus attack speed while Soul Ignition is active
duration of Soul Ignition before automatic recast
additional grey health stored based on missing health and elapsed duration
values.quote: '''Locke''' additionally stores up to {{pplevel|40 to 200}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} grey health for himself

values.meaning: current health threshold at/below which the missing-health grey health bonus is maximized
values.quote: his {{as|'''current''' health}} is at or below {{pplevel|150 to 450|color=health}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}
values.binNote: Bin gives only the level-1 (150) and level-18 (450) endpoints plus the 0.6 AP ratio; the wiki's intermediate levels are linearly interpolated from these two endpoints, matching LockeW#MaxHealingThreshold's formula shape.

values.meaning: mana-and-health cost drained per tick, as a fraction of current health
values.binNote: LockeW.HealthCost=0.02 is the per-second drain rate (2%/s); the wiki quotes it per 0.25s tick (0.5%), the same rate.
No bin row states a tick interval directly; LockeW.HealthCost=0.02 is expressed per second in the bin, and the wiki's 0.25s cadence is not present as a separate data value.

mechanics.claim: Locke stores grey health equal to 100% of post-mitigation damage taken from enemy champions while Soul Ignition is active.
mechanics.quote: he stores an amount of [[grey health]] on his [[health bar]] equal to 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}}, up to a cap

mechanics.claim: The recast (manual or automatic) ends Soul Ignition and heals Locke for the amount of grey health stored.
mechanics.quote: '''Locke''' ends ''Soul Ignition'' and consumes his [[grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount

mechanics.claim: Soul Ignition's cooldown does not begin until after the effect (and its recast) ends.
The recast becomes available 0.5 seconds after cast and happens automatically if not used manually before the duration ends.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, ''Soul Ignition'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

mechanics.claim: The health cost is based on Locke's current health at the time of each tick, not his health at the moment of cast, so it decreases as his health drops.
mechanics.quote: The health cost updates dynamically with '''Locke's''' {{as|'''current''' health}}, costing less the lower his remaining health is. It is not based on his {{as|'''current''' health}} at the time of cast.
